Title: Data-in replication for Azure Database for MySQL now generally available

Body.Content:
Azure Database for MySQL now supports data-in replication. Use data-in replication to synchronize data from a MySQL server running on-premises, in virtual machines, or database services outside Azure into the Azure Database for MySQL service. Learn how to configure data-in replication database services outside Azure into the Azure Database for MySQL service. 

Learn how to configure data-in replication.

 

Learn more about data-in replication.
